tools.name: prepare_recipe
tools.description: Propose column settings and variety aliases from CSV text. All proposed case sizes are 12 and need review. Returns a portable settings object. No data is kept.

tools.name: check_season
tools.description: Reconcile CSV transfers into box balances by holder and variety. Excludes shipped orders. Repeated moves count once and are flagged. Conflicting IDs stay unposted. Returns totals, source record links and paged exceptions. Free covers 10 sellers and one booth. Pro covers one named season.

tools.name: explain_row
tools.description: Return one logical source record and its ledger issues. Header is record 1. Quoted newlines stay within a record. CSV text is processed for this request and discarded.

tools.name: booth_template
tools.description: Return a blank-format CSV with example rows for a booth handoff, sale and return. Quantities are boxes. Replace the example variety and dates.

tools.name: pro_status
tools.description: Check a purchase code and its season. Returns free limits and sales status. Nothing is bought here.
